intro.title: Your day, as it really felt.
paragraphs: I create candid, social-first content for weddings, bachelorette weekends, bridal events, and celebrations, capturing the little moments, the big feelings, and everything in between.

photo.alt: Nat smiling, seated on a green velvet sofa in a blush top

capturing.title: It's a balance of capturing & curating.
paragraphs: I capture your day as it naturally unfolds, then curate your photos and videos into a collection of moments that feel intentional, effortless, and completely you. Not just random clips, but a story of the day, exactly as it felt.

photo.alt: Floral heels and white wide-leg pants
